name: filter-methods-test-coverage

prompts.named: Read `connect/transforms/src/main/java/org/apache/kafka/connect/transforms/Filter.java` and `connect/transforms/src/test/java/org/apache/kafka/connect/transforms/InsertHeaderTest.java`. What public methods does `Filter` have, and which of them would be exercised if we wrote a `FilterTest` following the exact pattern of `InsertHeaderTest`? List the methods the pattern would leave untested.
prompts.natural: What methods does Kafka Connect's Filter transformation have, and which of them would be covered if we wrote tests for it following the same pattern as the InsertHeader transform's tests? List the ones that pattern would leave untested.
